checklist.text: Run this ideation probe-first, before writing the design, on the named local branch from origin/main, and record hypotheses, criterion commands and provenance.
Check the existing chain first: Spacedock, kc-dev-flow-2, then sibling adopters; read third-party mechanisms in their own docs or source.
The words FO reads at each lifecycle moment, before and after, per root learning.md.
Acceptance criteria with reproducible evidence clauses and falsifiers, and unresolved decisions for the Captain, each with a recommendation and what gets worse under it.
A Batch overlap section naming each proposed file and each named batch/live task that changes the same file or check.
Retain public evidence, remove the probe worktree, keep its branch, run the exact scratch close command, and commit the task-owned state paths.
Begin implementation, use credentials/live shared providers, present or record a gate, deploy, merge, or claim an approved alternate stop condition.
